HTTP snapshot resolution state machine and result type.

# Purpose
This header declares the `fd_ssresolve` interface, which manages snapshot slot resolution for a peer over HTTP. It defines the `fd_ssresolve_result_t` structure for returning a snapshot slot and an optional base slot, along with the opaque `fd_ssresolve_t` state object used by the resolver state machine. The file also declares the memory layout helpers [`fd_ssresolve_align`](<#fd_ssresolve_align>), [`fd_ssresolve_footprint`](<#fd_ssresolve_footprint>), [`fd_ssresolve_new`](<#fd_ssresolve_new>), and [`fd_ssresolve_join`](<#fd_ssresolve_join>), plus the control functions [`fd_ssresolve_init`](<#fd_ssresolve_init>), [`fd_ssresolve_advance_poll_out`](<#fd_ssresolve_advance_poll_out>), [`fd_ssresolve_advance_poll_in`](<#fd_ssresolve_advance_poll_in>), and [`fd_ssresolve_is_done`](<#fd_ssresolve_is_done>). The `FD_SSRESOLVE_ADVANCE_*` values define the return codes used to report fatal error, retry, or success during state machine progress.
